method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reconstruction of the assignment-based relation-expression definition, verification of each arithmetic example and definability exercise, review of source correction OLFOL-024, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison after its documented projection. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Expressing and defining relations by formulas in a structure, arithmetic examples, relation operations, and definable finite and cofinite subsets of the natural-number order.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A predicate symbol directly expresses its interpreted relation because an assignment sending the displayed variables to a and b makes the atomic formula true exactly when Rab. Assignments are required because domain elements are not object-language symbols; connectives and quantifiers then let complex formulas define relations not built into the structure.
samples.checks: The symbol/element distinction, assignment coordinates, biconditional, atomic-to-complex progression and built-in-versus-defined contrast are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A formula whose only free variables are v1 through vn expresses an n-ary relation R exactly when, for every assignment sending vi to ai, the formula is satisfied precisely for the tuples in R.
samples.checks: Free-variable restriction, arity, universal assignment condition, coordinate equations and satisfaction biconditional are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: In standard arithmetic, formulas define non-strict order, successor, predecessor and strict order, so the less-than predicate is eliminable. More generally, a theory defines a relation when formulas systematically express it from the interpretations of the language's basic predicates.
samples.checks: All four arithmetic relations, both strict-order formulas, the redundant-symbol conclusion and the theory-level definition are retained; OLFOL-024 restores the missing object-language marker on the final v2.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The problems request arithmetic definitions of betweenness, divisibility and primality; formulas for inverse and relative product and an assessment of transitive closure; and definitions of every singleton, finite subset and cofinite subset of the natural numbers using only strict order and equality.
samples.checks: Every requested relation, restriction on the language, structure definition, six-item progression and cofinite biconditional are retained.

source_observations: OLFOL-024 records a missing object-language variable macro on the final v_2 of the second strict-less-than formula; Marathi restores it and structural QA projects back to the frozen notation for comparison.
Apart from OLFOL-024, all formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match the frozen source exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The compact Marathi adjective परिभाष्य remains open to specialist review in T238; the direct prime-number and divisibility evidence is recorded in MR-P108 and T239.
No TeX reader build was run for this individual unit.
